statusNotice: Celebrity prices, photo op times, autograph availability, panel times, participants, and group photo ops are subject to change. Check the app for the latest updates.
photoOpNotice: Arrive 5–15 minutes before your scheduled photo op. Do not arrive more than 15 minutes early. Admission is required separately, and times are subject to change.
autographNotice: Autograph availability is general and flexible. Guests may be away from their tables for photo ops, panels, breaks, or other scheduling needs.
panelNotice: Celebrity panel times and participants are subject to change. Check the app for the latest updates.
generalNote: Guest table prices supersede prices listed in the app if they vary. Combo pricing generally includes one autograph and one selfie unless otherwise noted. Professional photo ops are separate from table purchases.
